choices.label: Coordinate with Morris outside
choices.impact: Morris covers the perimeter while David checks the service route. Morris can watch for danger, but he needs you to share each clue before he can act.
choices.response: Morris covers the perimeter while David checks the service route. Ethan must come home alive.
choices.speaker: Detective Morris

choices.label: Decode the next lead with Amara
choices.impact: David checks the technical evidence. Amara connects it to the people and history behind the records, without police assistance.
choices.response: David preserves the original record and tests the next connection while Amara checks its meaning against what she remembers.
choices.speaker: David

choices.label: Scout the service entrance myself
choices.impact: David scouts quietly and sends his findings to Amara. You can investigate quietly, but no one will be close enough to help immediately if Victor is waiting.
choices.response: David scouts quietly and sends his findings to Amara. Ethan must come home alive.
choices.speaker: David

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: The factory lights are on. Victor brought Ethan here, and the outer gate is still warm.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: I can hear Ethan inside. We have one chance to reach him before Victor moves him again.

dialogues.speaker: Victor
dialogues.text: You found the door. Now prove you can get through it. I will be waiting on the other side.

police.speaker: David
police.text: Morris confirms activity by the loading bay. He will cover the outside while I investigate the service route.

signal.speaker: David
signal.text: David filters the factory transmitter. Amara recognises a faint sound; we need its source without alerting Victor.

alone.speaker: David
alone.text: I see fresh boot prints beside the service door. I send Amara my position and watch for a safe opening.
